method: Viewed all three original local PNGs via view_image; read exact Blender/geometry/camera receipt. No crop, resize or painted overlay.
observations: Both oblique views show the whole rectangular map base, boundary posts, four raised block buildings, central crossing/deck and opposing end stations within the frame; no visible mesh edge is cut by image borders.
The overhead view makes the two long side lanes, central crossing and repeated symmetrical blocks readable. It has generous empty horizontal margins because the map is longer than it is wide.
Front/rear obliques resemble each other because the model is largely bilateral. Their opposite camera positions are independently recorded; this is not a duplicated image.
Flat material blocks and simple geometry remain an original map study. Small labels/details are not legible at 480x360; no production-art or tactical-navigation acceptance is inferred.
limits: Source-asset still inspection only; no collision/support-surface query, deformation/motion/contact, native runtime integration or performance acceptance.
Post-render census images includes Blender Render Result with source VIEWER. That is a renderer buffer, not an imported texture; this original model uses eight flat materials.
Object/vertex caps occur after Blender import; file cap does not establish a general peak-memory bound.
accepted_scope: Three stills visibly reviewable, frame-fit evidence and raw-scale/census data; not final game-art acceptance.
